messages:
Alex Chen: Quick follow-up from the pm for the high-concurrency failure — I pulled the action list together, assigning owners and rough timelines. Please confirm or reassign by EOD.
Maria Gomez: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the current action table? I only saw the summary doc.
Alex Chen: pasted below (condensed):
- A1: Reproduce sequence causing tokenizer OOM under 95th percentile concurrency — owner: Maria, due: 2026-03-30, JIRA: RED-2109
- A2: Add graceful rejection + backpressure in gateway for short bursts — owner: Pranav, due: 2026-04-07, JIRA: RED-2110
- A3: Revise autoscale cooldowns and burst policy on Dedicated pools — owner: Jen (handoff to infra), due: 2026-04-14, JIRA: RED-2111
- A4: Add evaluators for regression detection (prompt set + latency SLO) — owner: Samir, due: 2026-04-21, JIRA: RED-2112
- A5: Postmortem writeup edits + RACI doc updates — owner: Alex, due: 2026-03-26, no-jira
Maria Gomez: I accept A1. I need help reproducing — can someone share the synthetic load script? @Pranav
Pranav Iyer: I pushed a simplified repro to /infra/sim-load with README. Use --tokenize-mode=fast and --concurrency 600 for the failing case.
Jen Park: For A3, infra will need a handoff from ops on current scaling rules. I'll pair with @Pranav next Wed.
IncidentBot: Created JIRA RED-2109 for A1 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2109)
IncidentBot: Created JIRA RED-2110 for A2 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2110)
IncidentBot: Created JIRA RED-2111 for A3 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2111)
IncidentBot: Created JIRA RED-2112 for A4 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2112)
Samir Patel: On A4, I'll scaffold a nightly eval job that runs the prompt set and alerts on >2% tail latency regression. Need test infra creds from @Alex.
Alex Chen: Sent creds via secure channel. Added myself to watchers on RED-2112.
Maria Gomez: RACI note: who is accountable for the final rollout decision on A2? I think that should be Product/PM + Eng Infra. Alex, can you add PM?
Alex Chen: Good catch. Updated RACI: Responsible=Pranav, Accountable=Maria (PM loop), Consulted=Jen, Informed=All oncall + eng. (I'll paste the RACI table to the postmortem doc.)
Pranav Iyer: For A2 implementation, propose feature-flagged rollout + 50% canary for 48h. Will open RFC in RED-2110 comments.
Jen Park: Handoff checklist for A3 (infra):
- current autoscale config exported
- test plan for cooldowns
- rollback steps and metric thresholds
I'll pluck these into RED-2111.
Maria Gomez: Can we get weekly 15m sync for owners until all tickets are in "In Progress"? Suggested cadence: Tue 10:15am. Thoughts?
Samir Patel: Works for me. Add calendar invite and agenda: quick status + blockers.
Alex Chen: Calendar invite sent to participants. I'll jot down owner status in the postmortem doc after each sync.
Pranav Iyer: One more thing — recurring pattern note: observed similar tokenization spike in 2025-11 incident. I'm adding a cross-postmortem tag to RED-2109 so we can track recurrence and long-term mitigation.
Maria Gomez: Confirmed. Add 'recurrence' label and a checkbox for long-term mitigations in the ticket template.
Jen Park: If anyone needs a temporary owner during PTO, ping me; I'll take on short handoffs.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Please update your JIRA ownership fields and comment with acceptance by EOD. Closing the loop here but will post updates after the first sync. :thumbsup:
